decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to lock down the opponent by playing Stasis, preventing them from untapping their lands. By using cards like Forsaken City and various counterspells to protect the Stasis, the goal is to slowly chip away at the opponent's life total with cards like Black Vise while they are unable to play spells or develop their board. The deck plays a control game, disrupting the opponent's plans and eventually winning through attrition.

The focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and land denial. By utilizing cards like Standstill and Fact or Fiction, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by drawing cards and generating card advantage. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Swords to Plowshares and Wrath of God provides removal options for dealing with threats on the board. The deck also includes a land denial package with cards like Dust Bowl and Mishra's Factory, further establishing control over the game. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through careful resource management and control tactics.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Enchantress archetype to create a strong combo strategy. By utilizing cards like Argothian Enchantress, Enchantress's Presence, and Sterling Grove, the deck aims to draw cards and generate strong enchantments. The deck also includes cards like Replenish and Opalescence to maximize the power of enchantments on the battlefield. The focus is on ramping up mana with cards like Wild Growth and Serra's Sanctum, while also using control elements like Seal of Cleansing to disrupt opponents.

The deck focuses on using Oath of Druids to put powerful creatures into play quickly, while using control elements like Swords to Plowshares and Foil to disrupt opponents. It also includes card draw with Gush and Sylvan Library, and manipulation with Scroll Rack and Portent. Armageddon serves as a way to disrupt opponents' mana bases, while cards like Seal of Cleansing and Engineered Plague help to deal with threats. The deck also includes cards like Ancestor's Chosen and Shard Phoenix for additional threats, along with some alternate win conditions like Zur's Weirding and Words of Worship.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with low-cost Elf creatures to build up mana with Priest of Titania and Gaea's Cradle. Using Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to untap creatures for more mana acceleration. Survival of the Fittest helps find key creatures like Deranged Hermit or Multani's Acolyte to buff the board, while Anger and Masticore provide removal options. Biorhythm can quickly end the game by setting all players' life totals to the number of creatures they control. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient creatures and powerful combo potential.

The main strategy of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a large number of aggressive goblin creatures. The deck focuses on playing low-cost goblins quickly to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Key cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief help you to get your goblins onto the battlefield faster, while cards like Goblin Piledriver and Siege-Gang Commander give you the ability to deal massive damage to your opponent. The inclusion of cards like Gempalm Incinerator and Naturalize provides additional utility and disruption to help secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of aggressive Goblin creatures. Utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Warchief, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Goblin Ringleader provide additional power and card advantage, while Gempalm Incinerator deals with any potential threats. With a mix of creatures and removal, the deck aims to maintain board presence and finish the game quickly with a barrage of Goblin attacks.

The deck focuses on establishing a lock on the opponent by utilizing the Stasis card to prevent them from untapping their permanents. It includes various disruptive spells like Daze and Counterspell to protect the Stasis lock, while also utilizing cards like Gush and Impulse to dig for key pieces. The win condition is typically through a combination of Black Vise damage and card draw from Stroke of Genius. The deck aims to stall the game until the opponent is overwhelmed by the lock and runs out of resources.

The deck focuses on assembling the Aluren combo, which allows the player to cast creature cards for free. This combo is supplemented by cards like Birds of Paradise and Wall of Roots to ramp up mana quickly. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Mesmeric Fiend and Cabal Therapy for disruption and control. The creatures in the deck have various enter the battlefield effects that can be abused with Aluren, creating a synergistic and powerful combo deck that aims to outvalue the opponent quickly.

This aggro Elves deck focuses on ramping up quickly with mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Priest of Titania to play powerful creatures like Deranged Hermit and Multani's Acolyte. Survival of the Fittest helps with creature selection and Tangle Wire can disrupt opponents' plans. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful board presence, utilizing cards like Wirewood Symbiote and Quirion Ranger to keep the mana flowing. Gaea's Cradle is a key land that can generate a lot of mana when combined with the abundance of creatures in the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently ramp up mana using enchantments like Wild Growth and Sterling Grove, while drawing cards and gaining value with Argothian Enchantress and Enchantress's Presence. The deck also aims to control the board with cards like Elephant Grass and Swords to Plowshares, while utilizing combo pieces such as Replenish and Opalescence to win the game. The deck's synergy lies in its ability to generate resources, control the battlefield, and eventually overwhelm the opponent with a powerful combo finish.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with a fast and aggressive goblin tribal strategy. By using cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly put creatures onto the battlefield, combined with pump effects like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Piledriver, you can deal massive amounts of damage before your opponent has a chance to establish their own game plan. The inclusion of Gempalm Incinerator for removal and Siege-Gang Commander for token generation adds a level of versatility to the aggression, making it difficult for your opponent to effectively control the board.

The focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive red creatures and burn spells, aiming to reduce their life total to zero as quickly as possible. By utilizing efficient low-cost creatures like Jackal Pup and Mogg Fanatic, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, this deck can dish out massive damage in a short amount of time. Cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex provide additional reach and pressure, while cards like Grim Lavamancer and Seal of Fire ensure that the opponent's board stays under control.

The deck focuses on fast, aggressive gameplay by playing low-cost, hasty creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Using efficient creatures like Mogg Fanatic and Jackal Pup, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Incinerate, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent's life total before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of powerful finishers like Ball Lightning and Fireblast allows for explosive plays to end the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Price of Progress and Sulfuric Vortex to punish opponents for playing non-basic lands and prevent life gain.

The focus of this deck is to cheat out the powerful creature Phyrexian Dreadnought and protect it using a variety of countermagic and disruption spells. The deck aims to stifle the opponent's strategies while assembling the Dreadnought combo. By efficiently controlling the game, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's plans and win through an explosive combo finish with Phyrexian Dreadnought.

The Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and board state with cards like Duress, Diabolic Edict, and Cursed Scroll, while utilizing efficient creatures like Hypnotic Specter and Skittering Skirge for pressure. The deck also aims to deal incremental damage with cards like The Rack and Plague Spitter, while using utility lands like Cabal Pit and Mishra's Factory to control the battlefield. With a mix of discard spells, removal, and creature threats, this deck aims to grind the opponent down and control the game until victory.
